newsitem.title: USA: Perini Q4 loss $15.79 a shr after writeoff.
newsitem.headline: Perini Q4 loss $15.79 a shr after writeoff.

text.p: For the Three For the Twelve
Months Ended Dec. 31, Months Ended Dec. 31,

(a) The three month and twelve month periods in 1996 include a pre-tax writedown to net realizable value of $79.9 million on certain real estate properties due to a change in real estate strategy on these properties from holding them through the necessary development and stabilization periods to a new strategy of generating short-term liquidity. Net income before the writedown for the three month and twelve month periods in 1996 was approximately $3.5 million and $9.3 million, respectively. (b) The twelve month period in 1995 includes a charge, which aggregated $25.6 million, to provide for a liability related to previously disclosed litigation in Washington D.C. and downward revisions in estimated probable recoveries on certain outstanding contract claims. (c) Tax benefits relating to the 1996 loss and part of the 1995 loss have not been recognized due to certain accounting limitations. (d) Reflects the impact of dividends on preferred stock of $532 (or approximately $.11 per share), and $2,125 (or approximately $.45 per share) for the three and twelve month periods ended December 31st, respectively.
